test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: According to the passage which of the following statement is NOT correct?

options.text: The crust and the top of the mantle make up a thin skin on the surface of our planet.
Depending on the size of the mainshock, aftershocks can continue for weeks, months, and even years.

solution:
The correct answer is "**earth has 3 major layers.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We are required to select an option that is incorrect with respect to the given passage.
 
• Now, refer to the following lines from the passage:
 
 
• Line 4 of paragraph 2: The crust and the top of the mantle make up a thin skin on the surface of our planet.
 
 
• Thus, option 1 is correct.
 
 
 
• Line 3 and 4 of paragraph 2: The** earth has four major layers: the inner core, outer core, mantle and crust**. 
 
 
• **Thus, option 2 is incorrect in context of the given passage.**
 
 
 
 
 
• Option 3 and 4 are correct with respect to the given passage.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
